about: One satellite image per place, at village level: 4 by 3 km at 10 m to the pixel for villages, 8 by 6 km at 20 m for towns. No marker, nothing at the level of a house or a parcel. The files are in imagery/ in this repo; nothing is loaded from an outside server.
source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A, read from the Element 84 Earth Search catalogue and the open Sentinel bucket on AWS
licence: Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice: free, full and open; reproduction, distribution and adaptation allowed.
terms_checked: Against Roger Wilco Imagery's register of outside data sources, as read on 13 Nov 2026: Sentinel data may be republished with this credit.
roger_wilco: These images were made by this repo's own script. A run with Roger Wilco Imagery's own scene picker was blocked in this session; tools/place_imagery.py --engine rwi makes them again that way, and those would carry the credit 'Roger Wilco Imagery'.
